title: Friday software update meme
caption:
Some rules apply in production AND in the parking lot. 😅

IT folks, you know exactly why. Everyone else: deploying anything on a Friday evening is how weekends get ruined.

Tag the colleague who would 100% hit "Update now" anyway 👇

slides.heading: Car at 6 PM: Software update available. Install now?
slides.body: Me, who works in IT: Not on a Friday. Never on a Friday.
